channel.title: Fluxa Direct Updates
channel.description: Stable updates for Fluxa Direct on Apple silicon.

item.description:
Fluxa 2.6.1

  • Sparkle updates from About, with optional automatic checks in Customize. Download and installation require confirmation.
  • Optional Permissions & First Run setup for Accessibility, Automation, Bluetooth and Claude credential access.
  • Branded installer with an English first-launch guide.

Requires macOS 14 or later and Apple silicon. Users of v2.5.0 and earlier must install this first updater-enabled release manually once.

Fluxa is ad-hoc signed, not notarized. A changed signing identity may require renewed macOS permissions.
